objective: Run all 20 prepared AC strategies, compare with previous methods, and update the research report from actual saved results.
execution_path: Native collaboration tool calls; root coordinates mechanics. No CLI substitution or fabricated independent role evidence.
actual_invocations_count: Count every actual spawn and follow-up turn separately, including failed starts and preparation/audit roles.
scope: All AC01–AC20. Select each card's applicable agent branch and required controls explicitly; preserve human-only outcome limits. Compare matched earlier methods and inspect the full archived prior repertoire. No gate or unknown may be presented as zero benefit or completed learning.
preparation_plan: One independent protocol/adapter preflight before scored generation.
repair_policy: Preserve first scored outputs and assessments. A preflight fixture can be repaired before source freeze. Later repairs must be separately versioned attempts within the prospective total, not silent overwrite/regrade.
source_preservation: No earlier run inputs, raw outputs, scores, freezes or closeouts may be changed.
